description: Layout preferences for Template.pptx (S4C reference deck). Rules bias the Master Swap picker toward layout choices this template's designer prefers; typography overrides pin body text size when the master default differs from the template's intended size; cover_chapter_divider synthesizes an extra chapter-divider slide from decorative text found on a source cover slide. The generic structural scorer remains authoritative when no rule matches, and templates without a preferences file inherit master typography as normal and produce a 1:1 slide count.

rules.name: high-content text slides prefer 2 Column split
source Section Header slides prefer dark 1 Column
